pain: Finding a meeting slot across three calendars takes too long
quote: Every time I need to book a client call I open three calendars and compare them by eye. It takes me twenty minutes for a thirty minute call. Then I still have to email the other side to confirm, wait…

pain: Back-and-forth emails to agree a time
quote: We send five or six emails just to agree a time for one demo. Prospects give up before we ever confirm the slot.
Getting a calendar integration through our review board took four months. By then the team had gone back to email threads to schedule meetings.

pain: Scheduling is why we chose you
quote: Smart scheduling was the reason we picked you over the other vendors. Meetings with customers get booked in a couple of clicks and that has changed how we work.
